images.caption: Two Tarahumara women (one with a baby nursing) at Arareco Lake near Creel, Chihuahua, Mexico. The Tarahumara are indigenous people of the Sierra Madre Occidental mountains in the state of Chihuahua in Mexico. The Tarahumara women wear the traditional, brightly colored clothes they are famous for. These women make and sell hand-made items at the lake.
